trigger.expression: last(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/uptime)<600 or change(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/uptime)<0
trigger.name: OLT FiberHome: Equipamento Reiniciou (Uptime < 10m)
trigger.description: O equipamento reiniciou recentemente ou perdeu energia.

trigger.name: OLT Inacessível (sem resposta SNMP por 1h)
trigger.description: Nenhuma resposta SNMP foi recebida da OLT nos ultimos 60 minutos. Equipamento pode estar desligado ou com fibra de uplink rompida.

trigger_prototype.name: Card CPU Slot ["{#SNMPINDEX}"]: Uso elevado (>90% por 10m)
Card MEM Slot ["{#SNMPINDEX}"]: Uso elevado (>90% por 10m)

trigger_prototype.expression: last(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/cardStatus.["{#SNMPINDEX}"])=9 and change(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/cardStatus.["{#SNMPINDEX}"])<>0 and count(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/cardStatus.["{#SNMPINDEX}"],10m)>1
trigger_prototype.name: Card Status Slot ["{#SNMPINDEX}"]: Placa com defeito (Faulty)

trigger_prototype.expression: last(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/cardStatus.["{#SNMPINDEX}"])=4 and change(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/cardStatus.["{#SNMPINDEX}"])<>0 and count(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/cardStatus.["{#SNMPINDEX}"],10m)>1
trigger_prototype.name: Card Status Slot ["{#SNMPINDEX}"]: Placa Desconectada / Offline

trigger_prototype.expression: last(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/cardStatus.["{#SNMPINDEX}"])=11 and change(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/cardStatus.["{#SNMPINDEX}"])<>0 and count(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/cardStatus.["{#SNMPINDEX}"],10m)>1
trigger_prototype.name: Card Status Slot ["{#SNMPINDEX}"]: Placa Sem Energia (Power Off)

trigger_prototype.expression: last(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/cardStatus.["{#SNMPINDEX}"])=2 and change(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/cardStatus.["{#SNMPINDEX}"])<>0 and count(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/cardStatus.["{#SNMPINDEX}"],10m)>1
trigger_prototype.name: Card Status Slot ["{#SNMPINDEX}"]: Placa Fora de Servico (Not in Service)

item_prototype.name: Card Type Slot ["{#SNMPINDEX}"]
item_prototype.description: Column Description: 260:EC2 724:EC2-X 16384:AC16 the other type could see the card type table

discovery_rule.name: NETSTREAM - Descoberta de PONs GPON FiberHome

trigger_prototype.expression: last(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.port.ifoperstatus.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],#1)=2 and last(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.port.ifoperstatus.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],#2)=1 and count(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.port.ifoperstatus.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],10m)>1
trigger_prototype.name: PON {#NETSTREAM.PON_NAME}: Porta GPON Inativa

trigger_prototype.expression: last(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}])=0 and change(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}])<>0 and count(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],180)>1
trigger_prototype.name: PON {#NETSTREAM.PON_NAME}: Queda total de ONUs

trigger_prototype.expression: (max(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.dg.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],900s)-min(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.dg.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],900s))>=3 and count(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.dg.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],180s)>1
trigger_prototype.name: PON {#NETSTREAM.PON_NAME}: DyingGasp detectado (Energia)

trigger_prototype.expression: (max(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.los.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],900s)-min(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.los.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],900s))>=3 and count(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.los.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],180s)>1
trigger_prototype.recovery_expression: last(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.los.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}])<=min(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.los.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],7d)+2
trigger_prototype.name: PON {#NETSTREAM.PON_NAME}: LOS detectado (Fibra)
trigger_prototype.description: 3 ou mais ONUs passaram a ter LOS como motivo de queda nos ultimos 15 minutos. Possivel rompimento de fibra na PON {#NETSTREAM.PON_NAME}.

trigger_prototype.expression: change(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}])<-{$GPON_DROP_MIN} and last(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}])>0 and count(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],180s)>1
trigger_prototype.name: PON {#NETSTREAM.PON_NAME}: Queda parcial de ONUs
Uplink {#IFDESC} - Alto volume de drops de entrada (>10/s por 5min)
Uplink {#IFDESC} - Alto volume de drops de saida (>10/s por 5min)

trigger_prototype.expression: max(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.uplink.status[{#SNMPINDEX}],#3)=2 and change(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.uplink.status[{#SNMPINDEX}])<>0 and count(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.uplink.status[{#SNMPINDEX}],10m)>1
trigger_prototype.name: Uplink {#IFDESC}: Link DOWN

item_prototype.name: ONU Dedicada {#NETSTREAM.ONU_DESC}: Motivo da Ultima Queda

trigger_prototype.expression: min(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.dedicado.status[{#SNMPINDEX}],#3)=4 and change(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.dedicado.status[{#SNMPINDEX}])<>0 and count(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.dedicado.status[{#SNMPINDEX}],10m)>1
trigger_prototype.name: ONU Dedicada {#NETSTREAM.ONU_DESC}: LOS (Perda de Sinal Optico)

trigger_prototype.expression: last(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.dedicado.rxpower[{#SNMPINDEX}])<=-28 and last(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/netstream.dedicado.rxpower[{#SNMPINDEX}])>-40
trigger_prototype.name: ONU Dedicada {#NETSTREAM.ONU_DESC}: Sinal Optico Critico ({{ITEM.LASTVALUE1})
trigger_prototype.description: Sinal optico da ONU dedicada extremamente baixo (< -28 dBm). Risco iminente de queda do link.

trigger_prototype.expression: last(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/oltPonAuthOnuNum[{#SNMPVALUE}])>=127 and count(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/oltPonAuthOnuNum[{#SNMPVALUE}],10m)>1
trigger_prototype.name: {#SNMPVALUE} PON cheia. Numero de ONUs ({ITEM.LASTVALUE})

trigger_prototype.expression: (last(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/oltPonOnlineStatus[{#SNMPVALUE}])=0)and(last(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/oltPonAuthOnuNum[{#SNMPVALUE}],#2)>2) and change(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/oltPonOnlineStatus[{#SNMPVALUE}])<>0 and count(/Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM/oltPonOnlineStatus[{#SNMPVALUE}],10m)>1
trigger_prototype.name: gpon_{#SNMPVALUE}:
